Small non-interactive label used to flag status, category, or count next to other content.

## Variants

**default** — neutral tag for general labels or categories; the standard treatment when nothing needs to stand out.

**accent** — brand-tinted tag for a status or category that should draw attention, e.g. "New" or a highlighted count.
